items.title: MeerKAT Radio Telescope: Technology, Design, and Role in SKA
items.summary: An in-depth exploration of the MeerKAT radio telescope, detailing its technical design, operational principles, signal processing, and its crucial role as a precursor to the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) in the Karoo region of South Africa.

items.title: Susan Glaspell: Early Short Fiction, Journalism, and American Drama
items.summary: An exploration of Susan Glaspell's career as a pioneering American journalist, short story writer, novelist, and co-founder of the Provincetown Players.
items.note: An overview of Susan Glaspell's life, early short stories, journalism, and her pioneering role in modern American drama.

items.title: The Rules of the Institution and Other Stories: Themes and Context
items.summary: An exploration of Susan Glaspell's newly compiled collection of early 20th-century short stories, highlighting their portrayal of resolute women and groundbreaking feminist themes.
